name: Customer Relationship Management Software
summary: Adversaries may leverage Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software to mine valuable information. CRM software is used to assist organizations in tracking and managing customer interactions, as well as storing customer data. Once adversaries gain access to a victim organization, they may mine CRM software for customer data. This may include personally identifiable information (PII) such as full names, emails, phone numbers, and addresses,…

strategies.name: Detecting Suspicious Access to CRM Data in SaaS Environments

analytics.name: Analytic 1520
analytics.guidance: Anomalous high-volume access to customer records in CRM software by a non-CRM admin user account, especially following initial authentication from a rare location or device. Behavior includes abnormal access to PII fields or data exports within a short time window.
